high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the verified user "madisonbeer." The post features a close-up photograph of three individuals' forearms, showcasing their matching tattoos. Each person has a tattoo of a bow on their inner forearm, with one additional tattoo on the back of each hand. The tattoos appear to be black ink designs. The individuals are wearing casual clothing; one is wearing a black top, another a gray top, and the third is partially visible but appears to be wearing a dark jacket. They are also wearing gold bracelets on their wrists, which have a floral design.
